agentWrite.title: How agents change pages
agentWrite.hint: Applies to agents whose level allows writing (level 3). Level 2 agents only ever propose.

explain.propose: Agents propose changes; a moderator accepts or rejects them.
explain.direct: Level 3 agents write pages directly. A version is always kept first; pages locked for AI stay untouched.

proposals.title: Proposals
proposals.hintModerator: Changes to pages that agents proposed. You accept or reject them.
proposals.hintEditor: Changes to pages that agents proposed. Moderators accept or reject them.
proposals.noAccess: Proposals are seen by people who edit this space's pages.
proposals.outdated: The page has changed since the proposal. Accepting shows a merge of both.
proposals.tooLarge: The texts are too long to compare.
proposals.noChange: The proposal does not change the content.

reject.title: Reject proposal
reject.hint: The page stays as it is. Whoever made the proposal sees the reason.

merge.title: The page has changed
merge.hint: The page was edited after the proposal. Check what comes together and accept the merged text.
merge.again: The page has changed once more. The merge was worked out again.
merge.meanwhile: What changed on the page since
merge.sameVersion: The changes are in the newest version (live editing); the merge below shows them.
merge.tooLarge: The texts are too long to merge here. Reject the proposal, or carry the change into the page yourself.
merge.clean: Proposal and page merge without a conflict.
merge.conflicts_one: {{count}} place was changed on both sides. Choose what holds for each.
merge.conflicts_other: {{count}} places were changed on both sides. Choose what holds for each.
merge.textHint: Written into the page like this. Another choice above puts the text together again.

proposal.not_found: This proposal does not exist (any more).
proposal.not_open: This proposal has been decided already.
proposal.version_conflict: The proposal has changed meanwhile; it was reloaded.
proposal.base_outdated: The page has changed since the proposal.
proposal.page_trashed: The page is in the trash now; the proposal cannot be accepted.
proposal.page_no_ai: The page is locked for AI now; an agent's proposal cannot be accepted.
proposal.parent_gone: The parent page is gone or in the trash.
